articles.title: Heidi Klum stuns in her spectacular new Halloween costume: A bloody amputated hand
articles.standfirst: Known for modelling, Klum has become infamous for her bold Halloween costume choices
articles.summary: Known for modelling, Klum has become infamous for her bold Halloween costume choices
articles.body:
Heidi Klum celebrated the 25th anniversary of her famous Halloween party with another extraordinary transformation, arriving in New York City dressed as a gigantic, bloodied severed hand.

The German-American supermodel once again demonstrated why she has earned her reputation as the Queen of Halloween as her elaborate costume featured realistic veins, rotting flesh and a bloody wrist, with Klum 's head positioned in the center of the enormous hand.

The replica even included details from her real left hand, including her green stone wedding ring and the tattoo reading "Tom" in honor of husband Tom Kaulitz as Klum made a dramatic entrance at Cathedrale Restaurant at Moxy East Village .

Arriving in a truck covered with red "DANGER" signs as actors wearing yellow hazmat suits then helped her out, completing the theatrical presentation of her gruesome appearance.

The 53-year-old had been teasing the costume on social media for a week, offering followers glimpses of the prosthetics and disturbing details involved in the transformation.

Earlier previews showed what appeared to be decaying flesh and exposed internal organs, while another photograph featured a mannequin seemingly made to her measurements.

Her husband, Tokio Hotel guitarist Kaulitz , has traditionally participated in her elaborate Halloween appearances, often dressing to complementary to her, but he was not present at this year's celebration, leaving her to command attention on her own.

The annual event, presented by Apothic and Butterfinger , has become one of the most anticipated celebrity Halloween gatherings in New York and Klum 's commitment to increasingly elaborate costumes has helped turn the party into an entertainment spectacle in its own right.

Why is Heidi Klum known as the Queen of Halloween?

Klum began hosting her famous Halloween parties in 2000 and has spent more than two decades raising expectations with increasingly ambitious transformations as her costumes have included Jessica Rabbit , Princess Fiona from Shrek , an elderly version of herself and the werewolf from Michael Jackson's Thriller video.

Her giant earthworm costume in 2022 became an internet sensation, with Kaulitz dressed as a fisherman. In 2023, she transformed into an enormous peacock, using Cirque du Soleil performers to create its spectacular feathers.

The following year, the couple appeared as E.T. from the hit Steven Speilberg film of the 1980s complete with extensive prosthetics but Klum 's career extends well beyond Halloween .

Born in Europe in 1973, she rose to international prominence after appearing on the cover of Sports Illustrated's Swimsuit Issue in 1998 and she subsequently became the first German model to achieve Victoria's Secret Angel status.

She later established herself on television as host and executive producer of Project Runway , before joining America's Got Talent as a judge as her achievements include an Emmy Award in 2013, while her annual Halloween celebrations have become another defining part of her entertainment career.

articles.title: Sydney Sweeney completely changes her style and surprises alongside Scooter Braun: as “party animals” on Halloween
articles.standfirst: The actress set aside her usual sensual and glamorous image to celebrate Halloween with an unexpected couples costume alongside the music executive.
articles.summary: The actress set aside her usual sensual and glamorous image to celebrate Halloween with an unexpected couples costume alongside the music executive.
articles.body:
Sydney Sweeney usually draws attention for her sensual and glamorous looks, but this time she decided to completely change gears. For Halloween, the actress surprised everyone by appearing alongside her boyfriend, Scooter Braun, in a much more understated and fun couples costume.

The 29-year-old Housemaid star and the 45-year-old music executive got into the Halloween spirit with matching brown animal pajamas . The two posed very close together in a sweet mirror selfie, in an image that showed a much more relaxed side of the couple.

“Happy Halloween from your favorite party animals”

The detail that accompanied the photograph ended up giving the costume meaning. Over the image, the couple wrote: “ Happy Halloween from your favorite party animals 👻 ”, a phrase that plays on their animal-like appearance and turns the post into a Halloween card.

The change also contrasts with the more sensual image Sweeney usually projects. On this occasion, the actress opted for comfort and shared the moment with Braun in a selfie in which the two appear very close together.

This isn't the couple's first costume of the year. In August, the actress had shown off her figure in a Wonder Woman-inspired bustier during a fun-filled getaway, while for this occasion she opted for a fully covered and much more relaxed outfit.

Sydney Sweeney and Scooter Braun, very close

In the photograph, Scooter Braun appears embracing Sydney while she smiles in front of the mirror. The actress kept her signature blonde mane, which she wore longer than ever, falling in loose waves over her shoulders, looking very much in love.

The couple’s appearance comes after Sydney Sweeney became one of Hollywood’s most talked-about figures for her roles in productions such as Euphoria and Housemaid. This time, however, the attention was focused on a much more casual and romantic side of the actress.

Now, the contrast was total: far from superhero suits and the most eye-catching styles, the two chose animal pajamas to celebrate Halloween with a simple photograph and a message with a sense of humor.

articles.title: Lao Tzu, Chinese philosopher: "When you are content to be simply yourself and don't compare or compete, everyone will respect you"
articles.standfirst: Tzu is one of the most significant philosophers in the history of Taoism
articles.summary: Tzu is one of the most significant philosophers in the history of Taoism
articles.body:
Lao Tzu , also known as Laozi , is traditionally regarded as the founder of Taoism and one of the most influential thinkers in Chinese philosophy as his teachings explored how people could find wisdom, balance and fulfilment by living in harmony with the natural world. Although historians continue to debate whether he was a single historical figure, Lao Tzu is credited with writing the Tao Te Ching , a collection of 81 chapters became a foundational work of Taoist thought, examining existence, leadership, human behavior and the meaning of a balanced life.

And one teaching attributed to Lao Tzu captures his belief in accepting oneself rather than chasing approval, "When you are content to be simply yourself and don't compare or compete, everyone will respect you.” Its message challenges the idea that personal worth depends on outperforming others as the statement begins with contentment, an idea central to Lao Tzu 's philosophy that recognizing that happiness does not have to depend on wealth, status or recognition. It requires understanding what genuinely matters. Comparison can make that difficult because it encourages people to measure their lives against someone else's achievements. There will always be another person with greater success, possessions or influence, but constantly chasing those standards can leave satisfaction permanently out of reach. Lao Tzu 's emphasis on simplicity offers a different perspective of rather than seeking more simply because others have it, people should recognize when they already have enough as his philosophy suggests that reducing unnecessary desires can create greater peace than pursuing endless rewards.

Why does Lao Tzu’s quote still matter hundreds of years later?

The reference to competition also reflects his teaching of wu wei , often translated as effortless action or non-action but this does not mean avoiding responsibility or refusing to make an effort - it means recognizing when struggle is unnecessary and responding without forcing outcomes. Under that principle, life does not need to become a constant contest as people can pursue their goals without treating every achievement by somebody else as a challenge to their own standing, thus patience and measured decisions can be more productive than rivalry. Lao Tzu frequently used nature to illustrate why gentleness should not be mistaken for weakness as he likens water to the human hubris, for example, adapts to its surroundings and does not fight every obstacle, yet its persistence can gradually overcome even the hardest surfaces. That image helps explain why being yourself does not require aggression or constant self-assertion. Someone who is secure in their own identity has less reason to dominate conversations, seek attention or diminish another person's accomplishments to feel important. The promise of respect in the quote is therefore connected to authenticity and humility. People who do not continually compete for recognition can demonstrate confidence without arrogance, while their willingness to accept others creates room for more genuine relationships. Ultimately, the message is not that ambition or achievement should be abandoned. It is that neither should determine a person's value.

articles.title: Michael Mann health update: Director rushed to hospital after shooting himself in the leg
articles.standfirst: It was all an accident while trying to draw his weapon at a shooting range
articles.summary: It was all an accident while trying to draw his weapon at a shooting range
articles.body:
Renowned director Michael Mann , 83, was rushed to a Los Angeles hospital after accidentally shooting himself in the leg with a firearm while practicing at a shooting range.

The events occurred this Saturday, November 31, on Halloween night, as reported by the American outlet TMZ. The filmmaker was trying to draw his pistol when it accidentally went off , and he had to receive immediate medical attention, which took place at around 4:00 p.m.

articles.body:
Megan Fox once again captured attention on Halloween, this time with a transformation that seems straight out of a dark fantasy film. The American actress shared a series of photographs on Instagram in which she appears transformed into a mysterious mermaid , with an aesthetic that combines sheer elements, metallic details, and an unsettling atmosphere.

However, it was not only the outfit that drew attention. The characterization included a particular detail on her hands and makeup full of small shiny adornments that reinforced the appearance of a creature emerging from the depths of the ocean.

The detail of Megan Fox's costume that completes her transformation

articles.title: Harry Styles receives a special Knicks honor, presented by Jalen Brunson
articles.standfirst: The Knicks star surprised the singer during the final night of Harryween.
articles.summary: The Knicks star surprised the singer during the final night of Harryween.
articles.body:
H arry Styles received a very special surprise to close out Halloween in New York City . On Saturday, October 31, during his final night at Madison Square Garden, Jalen Brunson stepped away from the basketball court and onto the stage to share an unexpected moment with the singer.

Wearing a cap that read “Techno Is My Boyfriend,” the New York Knicks star grabbed the microphone and introduced himself to the thousands of fans in attendance: “My name is Jalen Brunson and welcome to Madison Square Garden.” His words sent the crowd into a frenzy, with fans breaking into chants of “MVP,” the same cheer that usually greets him during Knicks games.

But Brunson had a much bigger reason for making an appearance than simply greeting the crowd. The player brought a commemorative banner for Harry, honoring his 30 consecutive sold-out shows at Madison Square Garden .

Brunson's joke that made Harry Styles laugh

And if the special recognition had already made Brunson's appearance a surprise, the Knicks star still had a funny story to share. He revealed that he had attended three of Harry's concerts, while the singer had only been to one of his games . With that playful comparison, Brunson jokingly reminded him that he still owed him another visit to the court.

Harry was quick to respond with his trademark sense of humor. The singer asked the audience to notice that the two were practically the same height, sparking a spontaneous exchange that made the moment even more entertaining.

Between the cheers, jokes and special tribute, Brunson's appearance became one of the most memorable moments of Harryween's final night . It was a Halloween send-off Harry is unlikely to forget, with a Knicks star taking the spotlight away from the court for a change.

articles.title: Buddha, religious philosopher: "No one saves us but ourselves. No one can and no one may. We ourselves must walk the path"
articles.standfirst: The Buddhist faith is based on the life of the Buddha, also known as Siddhartha Gautama
articles.summary: The Buddhist faith is based on the life of the Buddha, also known as Siddhartha Gautama
articles.body:
The Buddha 's philosophy begins with a demanding idea: meaningful change depends on the individual as his teachings examine the origins of suffering and how people can develop greater clarity through their choices, conduct and understanding. That outlook has shaped religious and philosophical traditions for more than two thousand years and although Buddhism emerged in a very different world, its questions about desire, hardship and the search for inner freedom remain familiar today.

One of the Buddha ’s best-known expression of personal responsibility appears in the words: "No one saves us but ourselves. No one can and no one may. We ourselves must walk the path." The message places transformation in each person's hands as known as Siddhartha Gautama before his awakening, the Buddha is traditionally believed to have lived in northern India in the fifth century BCE where suffering shaped his approach. Born at Lumbini , now in Nepal , he belonged to the Shakya clan and grew up in privilege with his father, Suddhodana , was a prominent ruler; Siddhartha married Yasodhara and they had a son, Rahula . But traditional accounts say four encounters, with age, illness, death and a wandering ascetic, led him to question worldly security and he left his privileged life to seek spiritual answers, studying with religious teachers and testing severe self-denial. He ultimately rejected both indulgence and extreme deprivation and adopted a balanced approach that became known as the Middle Way , Buddhist tradition says he attained enlightenment while meditating beneath a Bodhi tree at Bodh Gaya . Known thereafter as the Buddha , or awakened one, he spent the rest of his life sharing teachings about suffering and liberation.

Why the Buddha's quote remains relevant in modern society

The Four Noble Truths establish that suffering is part of life, that craving and attachment contribute to it, that it can cease, and that a path leads towards freedom as their message asks people to examine the causes of their distress. The Noble Eightfold Path sets out that route through right understanding, intention, speech, action, livelihood, effort, mindfulness and concentration. Impermanence and non-self also challenge attachment to changing circumstances and fixed identity. Nirvana means release from craving, ignorance and suffering, not a temporary feeling of happiness, and after the Buddha 's lifetime, his teachings spread beyond India, inspiring distinct traditions across Asia with a shared philosophical foundation. The quotation does not ask people to reject help. Friends, communities and professionals can offer vital support, but personal growth still requires participation. Treatment and encouragement can accompany individual effort and reflection. Social media comparison, professional setbacks and personal loss test how people understand their lives. The Buddha 's message is not that hardship is a personal failing, but that advice can show a direction while each person takes the steps.

articles.title: Oscar Wilde, author and poet: "Experience is simply the name we give our mistakes"
articles.standfirst: Wilde is one of the most celebrated poets in history
articles.summary: Wilde is one of the most celebrated poets in history
articles.body:
Born in Dublin in 1854, Oscar Wilde became one of the Victorian Era 's most recognizable literary figures, celebrated for his sharp humor, theatrical personality and criticism of social conventions. His writing frequently explored the contradictions between appearance and reality, making his observations about human behavior particularly enduring including celebrated works such as The Picture of Dorian Gray and The Importance of Being Earnest .

His reputation was built on clever dialogue, satirical observations and an ability to challenge the expectations of respectable Victorian society and his words have become timeless. And Wilde 's observation, "Experience is simply the name we give our mistakes," captures his ability to turn everyday human behavior into a memorable insight and has equally become timeless. The Irish writer suggests that errors should not simply be viewed as failures, but as experiences that can shape our understanding and influence the decisions we make as the quotation presents mistakes as an unavoidable part of acquiring knowledge. Rather than measuring experience solely through achievements or successful decisions, Wilde invites us to consider how much can be learned from the moments when things go wrong.

What does Wilde’s quote mean?

That idea remains relevant in modern life, where professional and personal success can create pressure to avoid errors as people are often reluctant to admit when they have made a poor decision. This is particularly true in environments where results and achievements are closely scrutinized however, mistakes can reveal weaknesses, expose assumptions and provide lessons that would be difficult to acquire through theory alone. A failed project, an incorrect judgement or an unsuccessful attempt can all offer information that helps someone approach the next challenge differently and the message also applies to relationships. Misunderstandings, disagreements and misplaced trust can be painful, but reflecting on those experiences may help people develop better communication, recognize their boundaries and understand what they expect from others. Wilde 's observation does not suggest that every mistake should be excused or that failure automatically produces wisdom as an experience becomes valuable when someone examines what happened, accepts their part in it and makes an effort to avoid repeating the same behavior. Fear of getting something wrong can also prevent people from taking opportunities as whether changing careers, learning a new skill or attempting something unfamiliar, the possibility of failure can discourage people before they have even begun. Wilde 's words offer a different perspective: making mistakes is not necessarily evidence of an inability to succeed, and it can be an indication that someone is testing their abilities, confronting uncertainty and gaining knowledge through experience.

articles.title: Sydney Sweeney is turning heads in her lingerie brand as her booming business reveals a side of her Hollywood never showed
articles.standfirst: The SYRN brand recorded its best quarter since launch and doubled its sales between July and September. One of its collections surpassed two million dollars in revenue, while several garments sold out shortly after hitting the market.
articles.summary: The SYRN brand recorded its best quarter since launch and doubled its sales between July and September. One of its collections surpassed two million dollars in revenue, while several garments sold out shortly after hitting the market.
articles.body:
Sydney Sweeney's lingerie brand is experiencing its strongest commercial moment since it launched in January 2026.

SYRN, the lingerie business and apparel venture that the American actress launched while continuing her career in Hollywood, recorded twice as many sales in the third quarter as in the second, according to data gathered by Page Six.

The growth is also reflected in the performance of its collections. September was the best month in the company's history, and sales were more than three times higher than the figures for June. Demand exceeded the available inventory, so some products sold out earlier than expected.

The collection that surpassed two million dollars

One of the main drivers of these results was Birthday Boobs, a collection that achieved the highest sales volume in a single day since SYRN was created. According to sources cited by Page Six, the line generated more than two million dollars and sold out in just 24 hours.

Among the most requested products was the Blue Ditsy lingerie set, which sold out on its first day of launch. The result confirmed the commercial appeal of a collection that became the brand's top-selling success to date.

The positive trend would not have been limited to September. The company estimates that in October it could close with a further 20% increase compared to the previous month, which would represent a new monthly record for the company.

Sydney Sweeney, from actress to entrepreneur

Sweeney launched SYRN in January 2026 with a proposal centered on underwear and garments tailored to different body types. The brand offers 44 sizes, from 30B to 42DDD, and organizes its collections into different lines, with styles ranging from comfortable designs to bolder options.

The actress also participates directly in promoting her products and fronts much of the advertising campaigns. That exposure has helped maintain interest around the brand, which has used images and ads with strong visual impact to present its new collections.

SYRN's next challenge will be to meet demand without running out of stock of its most popular products. The third-quarter results represent the company's best performance since its founding, although the figures released come from sources close to the business and not from a public financial report.

articles.title: Taylor Swift's quirky habit from her high school days makes Travis Kelce have to put up with it
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift still shares an inside joke with her best friend that dates back to their teenage years.
articles.summary: Taylor Swift still shares an inside joke with her best friend that dates back to their teenage years.
articles.body:
T aylor Swift may be able to fill stadiums, top the music charts , and turn almost any detail of her life into a hot topic, but there's one quirky habit she's held onto since her teenage years that you probably wouldn't expect: she still loves talking like a character from a 2000s comedy!

The story began when Taylor was just 14 years old and moved to Nashville to pursue her music career. She was the new girl in town, starting a chapter of her life filled with changes, but she soon found someone who shared her sense of humor: Abigail Anderson, who would eventually become one of her closest friends .

One of the inside jokes they came up with involved Napoleon Dynamite, the 2004 comedy starring Jon Heder . The two started imitating the main character's unusual way of speaking, and apparently, neither has found a reason to stop.

More than two decades after they first met, the tradition is still going strong. Taylor recently proved it in front of an audience that couldn't help but burst into laughter.

Taylor Swift brings back her teenage inside joke with a hilarious impression

The story came up during a conversation in New York with Andrew Stanton, director of Toy Story 5 , and moderator Jessica Shaw , following a screening of the film. While discussing the importance of finding people who share your sense of humor, Taylor recalled the unique connection she had formed with Abigail.

The singer explained that the two used to talk like the main character in Napoleon Dynamite . But she didn't just tell the story; she decided to give everyone a little demonstration, imitating the character's signature deep, monotone voice in front of the audience. The result was plenty of laughter and a reminder that some inside jokes never get old.

Beyond the funny confession, Taylor also explained why that connection means so much to her. The movie made her think about how special it is to find someone you can share your sense of humor with without holding back, even when it means doing the most ridiculous things.

And Abigail seems to be exactly that person. From their teenage years in Nashville to their lives today, the two have maintained a friendship that needs very little explanation. Still, Travis Kelce may have to get used to his fiancée occasionally swapping her usual voice for that of Napoleon Dynamite .

articles.summary: The 35th President of the United States built his legacy around challenging conventional thinking in the Cold War
articles.body:

Although his presidency lasted less than three years, Kennedy confronted nuclear confrontation, racial inequality and the growing competition between the United States and Soviet Union .

His leadership during the Cuban Missile Crisis , commitment to the space race and growing support for civil rights helped establish a legacy that continues to shape discussions about American leadership. And one of his most thought-provoking observations offers an insight into the principles that defined his public life as Kennedy once said, "Too often we enjoy the comfort of opinion without the discomfort of thought." The quotation challenges people to look beyond their existing beliefs and question whether their opinions are supported by genuine consideration as it suggests that forming an opinion is easy, particularly when it reinforces what someone already believes. However, it is thinking critically requires effort, openness and a willingness to confront uncomfortable possibilities and his political career demonstrated the importance of that distinction, particularly when decisions carried consequences far beyond his own administration. Born on May 29, 1917, in Brookline, Massachusetts , Kennedy grew up in a prominent political family as his father, Joseph P. Kennedy Sr. , was a wealthy businessman and diplomat, while his mother, Rose Kennedy , raised nine children. After graduating from Harvard University in 1940, Kennedy published Why England Slept , examining Britain 's lack of preparation for the S econd World War and his own experiences in Europe during the war helped shape his outlook as the Allies overcame Nazi Germany .

Serving in the US Navy , Kennedy commanded the patrol torpedo boat PT-109 , which was struck by a Japanese destroyer in August 1943 but despite sustaining injuries, he helped rescue members of his crew, earning the Navy and Marine Corps Medal . After entering politics in 1946, Kennedy served in the House of Representatives before winning a Senate seat in 1952 and his national profile continued growing, particularly after Profiles in Courage won the Pulitzer Prize for Biography in 1957. His election victory over Richard Nixon in 1960 made him the youngest person ever elected president at 43 and his inaugural address at the Capitol Building famously captured his belief in public responsibility. However, he quickly discovered that leadership required more than inspiring speeches. His administration suffered an embarrassing setback with the failed Bay of Pigs invasion in 1961, when Cuban exiles attempted to overthrow Fidel Castro 's government with American backing and the following year brought an even greater challenge. When surveillance discovered the USSR ’s nuclear missiles in Cuba , Kennedy faced pressure to respond decisively without triggering a war as he ultimately ordered a naval quarantine and pursued negotiations with Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev , eventually securing an agreement to remove the weapons. His handling of the Cuban Missile Crisis demonstrated the value of considering alternatives rather than allowing immediate pressure to dictate decision and it also contributed to improved communication between Washington and Moscow and the 1963 Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty . Kennedy 's willingness to reconsider his administration's approach to foreign policy and international diplomacy avoided one of the tensest periods in all human history, a time when one wrong move could have results in the death of everyone alive – but his ambition did not stop there. He committed the United States to landing a man on the Moon before the end of the 1960s, challenging the country to pursue an objective that seemed extraordinary at the time and in 1969, NASA realized the dream as Neil Armstrong set foot on the Earth ’s satellite. On November 22, 1963, Kennedy was assassinated during a presidential motorcade in Dallas but more than six decades later, his legacy remains defined by his leadership during moments of extraordinary danger.

articles.title: Nicolas Cage admits he's homeless after life throws him an unexpected financial curveball
articles.standfirst: The actor had to temporarily leave his $10.5 million mansion in Malibu after a massive sinkhole damaged the property grounds.
articles.summary: The actor had to temporarily leave his $10.5 million mansion in Malibu after a massive sinkhole damaged the property grounds.
articles.body:
Nicolas Cage is going through an unexpected setback that has disrupted his daily life. The actor acknowledged that he is currently homeless , after a massive sinkhole appeared next to his mansion in Malibu, California, and caused damage that prevents him from returning to the property. The situation has forced him to stay temporarily in hotels.

The confession came during his appearance at Los Angeles Comic Con on October 31. Speaking about his plans for Halloween, the star of Leaving Las Vegas explained that this year he would not be able to welcome neighborhood children to his home. "At the moment I'm a little homeless," he commented.

The unexpected problem that changed Nicolas Cage's plans

The situation contrasts with the actor's real estate holdings, as he purchased the Malibu property in 2024 for approximately $10.5 million. The oceanfront residence has now become the center of a problem that goes beyond material damage: Cage cannot use it normally and has had to seek accommodation elsewhere.

The incident began in September, when heavy rains and coastal erosion caused the ground next to the home to collapse. The sinkhole eventually affected the vehicle entrance and part of the exterior structures. Images released at the time showed large cracks in the asphalt and fragments of the property falling into the hole.

The consequences of the sinkhole in the Malibu area

The problem was not limited to Cage's residence either. Local authorities declared an emergency in the area and noted that 31 properties had safety or access issues. Seven homes were initially declared uninhabitable, while another 24 were affected by difficulties in ensuring safe access for emergency vehicles.

During his appearance at Comic Con, Cage also explained how he had had to change his family plans for Halloween. Instead of welcoming trick-or-treaters at his residence, he was planning to take his four-year-old daughter August trick-or-treating around Santa Monica. Then, once the little girl had gone to sleep, he planned to watch The Shining, the horror film directed by Stanley Kubrick.

While he remains away from his home, the actor has begun arranging the work needed to protect the property . He submitted several permit applications to the authorities just days after the incident, including one to place sandbags on the beach and next to the house in order to reduce the effects of wave action and erosion.

He also obtained authorizations to remove the asphalt remains, prepare the ground stabilization, and carry out excavations to collect soil samples. For the time being, it has not been announced

articles.title: Gabriel García Márquez, writer: "No evil lasts a hundred years, nor does any offense endure over time"
articles.standfirst: Loneliness, a contemporary human challenge, can help us find connection and meaning, especially in an increasingly individualistic world, through García Márquez's reflection on existence.
articles.summary: Loneliness, a contemporary human challenge, can help us find connection and meaning, especially in an increasingly individualistic world, through García Márquez's reflection on existence.
articles.body:
The search for meaning in life becomes a universal challenge that affects everyone . The idea that "no evil lasts a hundred years, nor does any offense endure over time" evokes the fragility of human existence and the desire to find direction amid loneliness. The inability to enjoy the present often leaves people trapped in their longings, affecting their happiness and interpersonal relationships.

García Márquez, through his work " Variant of a popular saying, attribution questionable ," highlights how our internal struggles are, in essence, a reflection of the human condition. This approach invites us to reflect on our own insecurities and to question the validity of our perceptions, connecting with the reality of those who feel lost and seek authenticity in a complex world.

No evil lasts a hundred years, nor does any offense endure over time

The thought of Gabriel García Márquez and the lessons of his work

Gabriel García Márquez, known as one of the greatest exponents of Spanish-language literature , was born in Aracataca, Colombia, on March 6, 1927. Winner of the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1982, his work, which blends the real and the fantastic, reflects the complexities of Latin American life. His most famous book, "One Hundred Years of Solitude," is considered a masterpiece of magical realism, and his literary legacy has influenced countless writers around the world.

García Márquez's thought is deeply intertwined with the themes of solitude, cultural identity, and magical realism . Solitude is a common thread in his work, where the internal struggles of people to find connections in an increasingly individualistic world are explored. Like other authors of the Latin American boom, such as Julio Cortázar and Mario Vargas Llosa, García Márquez embraces a narrative that challenges literary conventions. His creation of Macondo symbolizes Latin American identity, and his ability to blend reality with the extraordinary allows the reader to reflect on their own existence.

articles.title: Sydney Sweeney and her major life shift: Why she is considering converting to Judaism because of Scooter Braun
articles.standfirst: Why Scooter Braun could be behind Sydney Sweeney's potential change of faith
articles.summary: Why Scooter Braun could be behind Sydney Sweeney's potential change of faith
articles.body:
Sydney Sweeney could be considering a major personal transformation as her relationship with music executive Scooter Braun reportedly moves towards a more serious commitment.

The Euphoria actress, 29, is said to be exploring the possibility of converting to Judaism, the faith in which Braun was raised.

According to reports, the couple have begun discussing marriage and starting a family, prompting Sweeney to consider embracing an important part of her boyfriend's religious and cultural background.

Sources cited by publications claim that Sweeney has already met with two rabbis to learn more about Judaism and what conversion would involve. However, neither Sweeney nor Braun has publicly confirmed the reports or announced any formal plans.

Speculation surrounding her interest intensified after the actress reportedly attended Rosh Hashanah services alongside Braun at Temple Sholom in Greenwich, Connecticut, on September 12. Her appearance was seen as a possible indication that she's taking an interest in understanding her partner's heritage and traditions.

Braun , 45, was raised in a Conservative Jewish household and is the grandson of Holocaust survivors Eva Wohlberg Braun and Joseph Braun.

He also shares three children, Jagger Joseph, Levi Magnus and Hart Violet , with his former wife, Yael Cohen . The pair married in 2014 and separated in 2021.

A relationship entering a new chapter

Sweeney and Braun were reportedly first drawn to each other during the wedding celebrations of Amazon founder Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sánchez in Venice, Italy, in June 2025. Following months of public appearances and speculation, they confirmed their relationship in April 2026.

Insiders have suggested that Braun is eager to marry the actress, with discussions about having children reportedly making their relationship even more serious. The couple are also said to be planning and designing a home together as they consider their future.

Converting to Judaism, however, involves considerably more than attending religious celebrations. The process typically requires guidance and sponsorship from a rabbi, religious education and a commitment to Jewish beliefs, customs and traditions. The length and requirements vary depending on the religious movement and individual circumstances.

Away from her reported romance, Sweeney is also generating excitement in the film industry. Former Bond girl Trina Parks recently suggested that the actress would be an excellent choice to play 007's next romantic interest.

Parks , who made history as the first Black Bond girl when she portrayed assassin Thumper opposite Sean Connery in Diamonds Are Forever in 1971, praised Sweeney's acting abilities, confidence and classic Hollywood appearance.

"Not only is she a talented actress, but has this Hollywood classic kind of style and poise, which really works for her projects and brand,” said Parks .

"I feel for modern cinema and film-making and the future of Bond, audiences want to see a woman opposite Bond who is independent and has ownership of her sexuality. Sydney has those qualities."

She believes modern audiences would appreciate a Bond love interest who possesses independence and confidence rather than simply serving as a romantic accessory to the famous spy.

articles.title: Jessica Alba's bloody Nancy Kerrigan Halloween costume sparks divided reactions online
articles.standfirst: The actress' recreation of the infamous 1994 figure-skating scandal sparked criticism, while other fans defended her Halloween outfit
articles.summary: The actress' recreation of the infamous 1994 figure-skating scandal sparked criticism, while other fans defended her Halloween outfit
articles.body:
Jessica Alba has reportedly deleted her Halloween costume photographs from Instagram after her unusual tribute to former figure skater Nancy Kerrigan sparked divided reactions across social media.

The 45-year-old actress shared the photographs on November 1, showing herself dressed as Kerrigan , while her friend Kelly Sawyer portrayed fellow skater Tonya Harding.

Their outfits referenced the infamous 1994 incident in which Kerrigan was attacked and struck on the knee by an assailant ahead of the Winter Olympics.

Alba wore a white figure-skating outfit, complete with ice skates and a bloodied bandage wrapped around her knee. Sawyer complemented the look with a sparkling maroon costume and a baseball bat, referencing the attack that became one of the most talked-about scandals in sporting history.

The pair wore their costumes to a Halloween celebration hosted by Vas J Morgan and Michael Braun . The party followed a “Hockey Horror” theme, which provided the inspiration for their skating-related appearances.

However, not everyone appreciated the celebrity duo's choice of costumes. Several Instagram users criticized the outfits, arguing that recreating an actual assault turned a traumatic experience into Halloween entertainment.

Some described Alba's decision as immature, while others questioned why she would choose an incident that had such a lasting impact on Kerrigan's personal life and professional skating career.

“Immature. We expect better, Jessica,” wrote one fan.

Social media reactions remain divided over Alba's costume

The 1994 attack involved Shane Stant , who was hired by Harding's ex-husband, Jeff Gillooly , to assault Kerrigan . The incident forced Kerrigan to withdraw from the U.S. Figure Skating Championships, although she later recovered and competed at the Winter Olympics.

Harding was subsequently banned for life by the U.S. Figure Skating Association following the scandal.

Despite the criticism, plenty of social media users defended Alba and Sawyer , arguing that Halloween is traditionally an opportunity for creative and humorous disguises.

Some Reddit users questioned why the costumes had generated such a strong response, pointing out that the incident happened more than three decades ago and has already inspired several films and television productions. Others suggested that people were becoming overly sensitive about celebrity Halloween choices.

“Eh. It’s been over 30 years, there’s been two feature films and, like, five made for TV movies about it,” one pointed out. “Seems like a pretty tame joke at this point,” wrote a fan.

Although Alba's photographs disappeared from Instagram, they reportedly remained available on her Threads account, where reactions were also mixed.

Some followers praised the costumes, while others maintained that making light of a real person's traumatic experience was inappropriate. Alba's representatives were contacted for comment, but no response had been reported.

The actress has previously shared her family's Halloween celebrations online. In 2024, she dressed as Coraline, sporting a blue wig, while her son Hayes and then-husband Cash Warren wore matching Beetlejuice-inspired outfits.

Hayes also appeared in this year's Halloween photographs wearing a vampire costume. Alba shares three children with Warren : daughters Honor , 18, and Haven , 15, and son Hayes , eight.

Meanwhile, Honor embraced a different pop-culture inspiration, sharing a TikTok video featuring a costume referencing the 2024 tennis drama Challengers. Her look drew inspiration from the film's central characters, played by Zendaya, Mike Faist and Josh O'Connor.

articles.title: Sydney Sweeney's holiday lingerie campaign crossed a line for some fans
articles.standfirst: The actress is facing backlash after turning familiar holiday movie characters into lingerie looks
articles.summary: The actress is facing backlash after turning familiar holiday movie characters into lingerie looks
articles.body:
S ydney Sweeney is no stranger to controversy , and her career continues to move forward despite the criticism that often surrounds her. This time, however, she has faced backlash from an audience that believes she crossed a line with her latest holiday lingerie campaign.

Nudity is not what sparked the debate. Instead, t he controversy comes from Sweeney posing in underwear while recreating characters from beloved Christmas movies , some of which are associated with childhood memories. Several fans argued that bringing these characters into a lingerie campaign was inappropriate and amounted to sexualizing children's films.

Familiar characters, unexpected looks

Sweeney dressed up as figures from popular Christmas and Halloween movies , but some of her character choices did not sit well with viewers. The campaign features her dressed as Kevin McCallister , the young troublemaker played by Macaulay Culkin in Home Alone , as well as Cindy Lou Who from Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas .

The images also show the actress wearing several lace lingerie sets inspired by characters from The Corpse Bride and White Christmas . While the campaign combines recognizable movie references with holiday-themed underwear, t he connection to characters originally portrayed by child actors became a major point of criticism.

Culkin was nine years old when he filmed the 1990 holiday comedy, while Taylor Momsen was just seven when she played Cindy Lou Who in the 2000 live-action adaptation of Dr. Seuss' famous Christmas story.

Fans question the campaign's concept

Many critics described the campaign as poorly thought out , arguing that the creative direction showed little consideration for the way audiences associate these characters with childhood . Others suggested that if the concept had been carefully considered before its release, the decision to move forward with it showed a lack of sensitivity.

The criticism was not simply about Sweeney wearing lingerie. Rather, fans questioned the decision to use characters from children's movies in a sexualized setting while presenting the concept through what appeared to be playful and innocent holiday imagery.

Her latest campaign has once again put her in the middle of a debate about the decisions surrounding her public image. Whether the backlash was anticipated or the result of a creative direction that failed to consider the audience's reaction, the response suggests that not everyone is happy with the way Sweeney's team is approaching her latest projects.

Kim Kardashian has sparked a celebrity fashion debate after getting the opportunity to wear one of Elizabeth Taylor’s most treasured pieces of jewelry.

The 46-year-old recently visited Bulgari’s store in Rome, where she tried on the late Hollywood actress’s spectacular emerald and diamond necklace. The multimillion-dollar creation was gifted to Taylor by her former husband Richard Burton and remains one of the most recognisable pieces from her legendary jewelry collection.

The special fitting was arranged as a surprise, with Bulgari employees carefully retrieving the historic necklace from its archives. Such is its importance that one staff member wore white gloves while handling the precious accessory.

Kardashian shared photographs of the experience on Instagram, expressing her excitement about wearing something that once belonged to someone she had admired for years. However, the pictures quickly divided social media users.

Some critics weren't impressed by the reality star's latest fashion moment, with one commenting that Taylor would be turning in her grave. Others questioned whether Kardashian should have been allowed to wear such an important piece of Hollywood history.

The discussion also revived controversy surrounding her 2022 Met Gala appearance, when she wore Marilyn Monroe's famous crystal-covered dress. Kardashian previously denied allegations that the historic garment was damaged during the event.

Despite the criticism, plenty of fans defended her appearance, describing the jewelry as breathtaking and praising how beautifully it complemented her outfit.

Kim Kardashian's special connection to Elizabeth Taylor

Kardashian's interest in Taylor's jewelry isn’t anything new, as she has repeatedly spoken about her admiration for the actress and revealed that she had a personal connection to the necklace long before trying it on.

During her Bulgari visit, Kardashian explained that she had previously spoken to Taylor over the telephone about the piece and its history.

She also recalled visiting the actress's home shortly after her death in 2011, where she was given an opportunity to see her extraordinary jewelry collection, furniture and personal belongings before everything was cleared out.

Kardashian's admiration for Taylor also led to her becoming an executive producer on a three-part documentary about the Hollywood legend. She interviewed Taylor for Harper's Bazaar, making her the last person to conduct an interview with the actress before her passing.

Meanwhile, Kardashian has another ambition that remains firmly on her agenda: becoming a lawyer.

Speaking to People at the New York premiere of All's Fair season two, she revealed that she's still thinking about taking California's bar exam again but doesn't currently have enough time to dedicate herself to studying.

"I’m going to take my time and wait until the moment is right, when I have some free time to focus on it,” she said.

Kardashian completed her four-year Law Office Study Program in May 2025 after beginning her legal journey in 2019. She passed California's baby bar in 2021 on her fourth attempt but didn't pass the full bar exam following her July 2025 sitting.

Despite the disappointment, she hasn't given up on her ambitions and has previously suggested she could eventually leave her celebrity career behind to become a trial lawyer.

articles.title: Jennifer Lopez stuns in daring Barbarella costume for Halloween
articles.standfirst: Jennifer Lopez channels Jane Fonda's iconic 1968 sci-fi character in a series of sizzling Halloween photographs
articles.summary: Jennifer Lopez channels Jane Fonda's iconic 1968 sci-fi character in a series of sizzling Halloween photographs
articles.body:
Jennifer Lopez took Halloween glamour into outer space, unveiling a striking transformation inspired by one of cinema’s most memorable science-fiction heroines.

The singer and actor recreated Barbarella , the adventurous space traveler made famous by Jane Fonda in the 1968 cult film.

Lopez shared a series of photographs on Instagram showcasing several looks inspired by the movie. One outfit featured a plunging white bodysuit with black detailing and matching knee-high boots.

In another, she wore a black ensemble layered with chainmail-style metallic fabric, a short skirt and silver accessories. A honey-blonde wig completed the retro-futuristic styling.

The photoshoot also included a particularly daring image in which Lopez posed with her back to the camera beside a male model portraying the winged character Pygar.

The performer, Holden Maples , was credited for his appearance. The images captured the theatrical atmosphere that made the original film so distinctive.

Lopez made the inspiration personal in her Instagram caption, referring to Fonda as the “original SPACE ANGEL” and expressing her affection for her former co-star.

She also described the costume as a tribute to her Monster-in-Law co-star, making the Halloween transformation a celebration of their longstanding connection.

A Hollywood friendship behind the Halloween tribute

Fonda’s Barbarella remains closely associated with the late-1960s blend of camp science fiction, extravagant fashion and playful sensuality.

Directed by Roger Vadim , the film follows a futuristic astronaut embarking on an unusual interplanetary adventure. Its imaginative costumes and Fonda’s memorable performance helped establish the character as a lasting pop-culture icon.

The tribute also highlights the relationship between the actresses beyond their shared comedy. Monster-in-Law marked Fonda’s return to acting after a lengthy break, with the 2005 production becoming an important career comeback.

The film eventually earned approximately $155 million worldwide, introducing Fonda to a new generation of moviegoers.

Their time together on set also produced some unforgettable moments. Lopez previously revealed that she felt nervous about filming a scene involving slapping Fonda , but accidentally injured her co-star's eyebrow with a large diamond ring.

“I was so afraid to hit Jane Fonda in the face or hurt her in any way,” Lopez said in 2019. “And really, her character was very much like her, and my character at the time was very much like me. I was so afraid of her.

“I don’t even think we were supposed to slap each other. I just remember afterwards, Jane had a blood blister at the top of her eye. My nail, like, went up into her eye.”

Fonda later joked about the incident, while both actresses have continued speaking warmly about their experience working together.

Lopez's Halloween appearance comes during another busy chapter in her career. Her music continues attracting fresh audiences, while fashion projects and high-profile brand partnerships keep her firmly in the spotlight.

Her hit single On the Floor has also enjoyed renewed popularity among younger listeners following its appearance in the Amazon Prime series Off Campus.

By choosing Fonda's iconic character instead of a more contemporary Halloween costume, Lopez delivered a glamorous tribute to a fellow performer.

articles.title: Chris Rock admits porn addiction destroyed his marriage and what was happening behind closed doors
articles.standfirst: The comedian acknowledged that his habits affected his relationship with Malaak Compton and opened up about the mistakes that marked their nearly 20 years together.
articles.summary: The comedian acknowledged that his habits affected his relationship with Malaak Compton and opened up about the mistakes that marked their nearly 20 years together.
articles.body:
From the moment they married on November 23, 1996, Chris Rock and Malaak Compton built a family together, welcoming two daughters, Lola Simone and Zahra. For years, their public appearances reflected the closeness and chemistry they shared . They seemed to have a solid marriage, but behind that image were problems that eventually drove them apart.

In an interview with GQ, Chris Rock opened up about one of the habits that took the biggest toll on his marriage: his pornography addiction . The actor admitted that his behavior kept him from being the husband Malaak deserved and changed the way he experienced intimacy. This isn't the first time he has addressed the subject. In his 2018 Netflix special, Tamborine, he had already discussed how consuming pornography desensitized him and affected his married life .

However, that wasn't the only reason their marriage struggled. Rock also acknowledged his infidelity, the times he failed to listen to Malaak, and how unkind he could be toward her . Looking back on that period, he admitted that for a long time, he believed he could do whatever he wanted without having to face the consequences.

To explain how he developed that mindset, he turned to a rather unexpected comparison involving Marvel superheroes. He explained that some characters, after discovering their powers, begin to believe they can do anything, only to eventually realize they aren't invincible. Something similar happened to him: he came to believe he could get away with anything until he was forced to face the consequences of his own decisions . It was a lesson that, as he acknowledged, left him deeply humbled.

Chris Rock says he has overcome his pornography addiction

Today, things look different. During the interview, the comedian said he has gone five or six years without watching pornography and has managed to leave that addiction behind.

On the romantic front, Chris Rock has also entered a new chapter with Simone Henault, whom he has been publicly linked to since 2026. She is a DJ, creative producer, and cultural strategist with experience in marketing, including a stint at Google.

articles.title: Hugh Hefner, Playboy founder: “I have slept with thousands of women, and they all still like me.”
articles.standfirst: The Playboy founder spoke about his conquests without the slightest hint of modesty.
articles.summary: The Playboy founder spoke about his conquests without the slightest hint of modesty.
articles.body:
H ugh Hefner was never exactly shy about discussing his love life. The founder of Playboy made seduction a central part of his public image and, for decades, portrayed himself as a man who had spent his life surrounded by women, parties, and romances.

In a 2007 interview with Esquire , the businessman made a statement that perfectly summed up how he saw himself. “I have slept with thousands of women, and they all still like me.”

But that wasn't his only revealing admission during the conversation. Hefner also shared his personal formula for approaching women, and, much to many people's surprise, it had nothing to do with a clever pickup line or an elaborate game of seduction.

Hugh Hefner had a go-to line for winning women over

When asked about his strategy for picking up women, Hefner claimed all he had to do was introduce himself. His line was as simple as it was direct: “My name is Hugh Hefner.”

Yes, that was it. At least in his eyes, his name and the fame he had built over the years were enough to get a conversation started. He didn't need a prepared speech or the perfect words. His answer also reflected the enormous confidence he had in the persona he had created for himself .

During the same interview, the businessman discussed the importance of sex in life and admitted that, for him, one of the best parts of any relationship was the beginning.

Hefner died on September 27, 2017, at the age of 91 . Still, his comments offer a glimpse into the way he spoke about his private life and the fame that followed him for decades. If there's one thing that becomes clear from that interview, it's that he never had much trouble bragging about being Hugh Hefner.

articles.title: Paris Jackson’s $600 million court fight centers on the trust her father left for his children
articles.standfirst: More than 17 years after Michael Jackson’s death, Paris is asking a judge to move money from his estate into a trust for her and her brothers
articles.summary: More than 17 years after Michael Jackson’s death, Paris is asking a judge to move money from his estate into a trust for her and her brothers
articles.body:
For Paris Jackson, the court filing is about more than a large number. It asks who controls the money her father intended to provide for his children and when they can rely on it. In a petition filed Oct. 29, Paris asked a Los Angeles judge to order a $600 million transfer from Michael Jackson’s estate to the family trust for her, Prince and Bigi. The judge has not approved the request.

Paris says the trust remains unfunded more than 17 years after Michael Jackson died. Her filing estimates that about $600 million could be transferred after potential liabilities are considered. She also cites an estate accounting showing about $850 million in cash and cash equivalents at the end of 2024.

The request is for the siblings’ shared trust, not a $600 million payment to Paris personally. Under the trust terms described in her petition, the children were to begin receiving income from their shares at 21 , with distributions of the principal scheduled at 30, 35 and 40. Prince is 29, Paris is 28 and Bigi is 24. Paris argues the delay leaves them dependent on executor John Branca to decide when and how much money they receive.

Why the estate says the trust is not fully funded

Paris’s filing points to more than $1 billion in cash generated before taxes and expenses through major estate transactions. Those include the sale of the estate’s interest in EMI Music Publishing for $287.5 million in 2018, the $22 million sale of Neverland Ranch in 2020 and a 2023 Sony deal involving Michael Jackson’s music and other intellectual property that generated $750 million upfront.

The estate says it cannot fully fund the trust until unresolved legal matters are settled, including a dispute with the IRS, which sought $700 million in taxes and penalties.

A spokesperson said a ruling significantly reduced the amount but that the case remains unresolved and could still change. The estate also rejected Paris’s claim that payments were withheld or reduced, calling it “a complete fabrication” and saying more than $200 million had already been distributed for the children’s benefit.

Paris’s spokesperson disputed that response, saying she had asked for a partial transfer and that Branca could have funded the trust earlier.

The disagreement goes to the heart of her filing: Paris argues that some money can be set aside for the siblings while other legal and financial questions remain open; the estate says it cannot fully fund the trust yet.

A broader dispute over the estate’s management

The trust petition is part of a wider conflict over how Michael Jackson’s estate is being managed. In a separate motion, Paris accused Branca of failing to submit complete financial accountings for 2023 and 2024 by a court-ordered deadline.

The estate says the accountings were filed ; Paris’s lawyers say they were deficient. She has also challenged the management fee paid to run her father’s business.

Branca is now the estate’s only remaining executor. Co-executor John McClain died in May. A judge is scheduled to hear Paris’s trust-funding petition and her challenge to the management fee on Dec. 4.

Michael Jackson died in 2009 at 50. Since then, his music and other assets have continued to generate major business deals.

The upcoming hearing will address how much money, if any, should now be moved into the trust and how the estate’s remaining legal obligations affect the children’s access to it.

articles.title: André Malraux, novelist: “Death only matters insofar as it makes us reflect on the value of life”
articles.standfirst: The French politician invites us to make the most of every second of existence
articles.summary: The French politician invites us to make the most of every second of existence
articles.body:
Human beings have always reflected on life and death , in the many forms and schools of thought that lead us to make the most of every second. The French novelist André Malraux is one of the great names who, in his time, wanted to share an interesting phrase about existence, the role of death, how people interpret it, and the approach it should have.

“The only importance of death lies in the extent to which it makes us reflect on the value of life ,” said this politician, who wanted to explain how human beings should understand death not as the end of everything and something after which there is only emptiness. For him, it should mean the urgency of making the most of every second of existence , since time is limited.

Making the most of life without forgetting death

Malraux argues that each individual must see death as something inevitable and, therefore, the limit for giving meaning to life , for making the most of every second and lending greater urgency to something that is not valued as it should be: time, leisure, and happiness. Every experience teaches us , and after death there will be no more.

Malraux's thinking is not necessarily pessimistic, but rather an invitation to action, as others such as Stefan Zweig or Norman Cousins had already done, advocating for a call to give greater importance to life, to what we have before us, to the present, without forgetting that one day we are going to die.

It is a way of forgetting how death has become, for many, a taboo subject that is nothing more than a denial of the end of life. For many, accepting the outcome of things makes fear disappear, and it is then that they begin to truly live.

articles.title: Child pornography found in Meghan Markle's father's house
articles.standfirst: The Philippine National Police confirm the facts
articles.summary: The Philippine National Police confirm the facts
articles.body:
After Thomas Markle Sr. 's son handed several devices over to the authorities last October, a forensic analysis revealed that they contain pornographic material involving minors . The investigation against Meghan Markle 's father “is still ongoing” and for now few details of the case are known.

The Philippine National Police (PNP) has confirmed to the EFE news agency that a large amount of child abuse and exploitation content has been found. “In the preliminary results of the forensic analysis, media files were identified containing various materials of child sexual abuse and exploitation,” said General Wilson Asueta , of the PNP’s Directorate for Investigation and Detective Management.

According to the few details revealed, no minor of Filipino or Cebuano origin has been identified, although there are numerous recordings of young people of Asian origin engaging in sexual conduct with adults .

Meghan Markle's brother confirms “thousands” of images involving minors

Authorities have not indicated whether Meghan Markle's father has been identified in these videos or whether the files or the devices themselves are registered in his name. Meanwhile, it is known that the police will file charges for online child abuse and exploitation. At the same time, the FBI and other United States authorities are cooperating to advance the investigation.

These developments come after, on October 23, Meghan Markle's brother told the newspaper The Sun that he had found “thousands” of images of underage children in boxes that his father kept at his home in Cebu , where he lived until last May.

According to what was said at the time, those files showed girls under 10 years old and some of those materials had been recorded at Thomas Markle Sr.'s house in Rosarito , in the Mexican state of Baja California.

articles.title: Joseph Campbell, American writer: ”We must be willing to let go of the life we planned so as to have the life that is waiting for us"
articles.standfirst: A reflection on change and uncertainty offers a different way of understanding disappointment, unexpected opportunities and personal growth
articles.summary: A reflection on change and uncertainty offers a different way of understanding disappointment, unexpected opportunities and personal growth
articles.body:
Most people spend years imagining how their lives will unfold, setting goals for their careers, relationships and personal achievements. Yet some of life's most important opportunities emerge precisely when those carefully constructed plans begin to fall apart.

American writer and mythology scholar Joseph Campbell explored this tension between expectation and reality through a philosophy that continues to resonate decades after his death in 1987.

One of his most widely circulated observations captures the challenge of accepting an uncertain future: “We must be willing to let go of the life we planned so as to have the life that is waiting for us.”

The statement suggests that personal fulfillment doesn't always come from following a predetermined path. Sometimes, it requires abandoning expectations that no longer reflect who we are or what we genuinely want.

Campbell 's message is not necessarily an argument against ambition or planning. Instead, it challenges the belief that success must follow a particular sequence of events, encouraging people to recognize possibilities they might otherwise overlook.

What Joseph Campbell's famous quote really means

The central idea behind Campbell 's observation is that change becomes more difficult when individuals measure their present circumstances against an imagined future that may no longer be achievable.

A career setback, the end of a relationship or an unexpected personal responsibility can disrupt years of preparation. Such experiences often produce disappointment because they challenge the identity people have built around their expectations.

Campbell 's philosophy offers a different perspective, suggesting that relinquishing an outdated plan can create space for unexpected growth rather than representing a personal failure.

His thinking was heavily influenced by his study of mythology, particularly the recurring stories in which ordinary individuals encounter unfamiliar challenges and emerge transformed by their experiences.

In his influential 1949 book, The Hero with a Thousand Faces, Campbell examined what became widely known as the hero's journey, a narrative pattern involving departure, adversity and personal transformation.

Although originally developed through the study of traditional stories, the concept also offers a framework for understanding the uncertainty and difficult transitions people encounter in everyday life.

The enduring appeal of Campbell 's words lies in their recognition that uncertainty is an unavoidable part of life, particularly when circumstances develop differently from what people anticipated.

That collection, edited by Diane K. Osbon , brought together reflections she had recorded from Campbell, helping preserve ideas that continued reaching audiences after his death.

Ultimately, Campbell 's message presents personal growth as a process of adjustment rather than strict adherence to expectations.

articles.title: Matthew Perry, actor and star of Friends: “Alcoholism wants you alone; it wants you sick; and then it wants to kill you”
articles.standfirst: Years before his death, the actor described the dangers of addiction
articles.summary: Years before his death, the actor described the dangers of addiction
articles.body:
Matthew Perry had everything that Hollywood success was supposed to deliver including international recognition, financial security and a starring role in one of television's most successful sitcoms. Yet the actor eventually discovered that none of those achievements could protect him from his struggle with addiction.

The Friends star spent years dealing with alcohol and prescription drug dependence while appearing before millions of viewers, often concealing the severity of his condition from the public.

Perry later became increasingly open about those experiences, explaining that his illness continued to affect him regardless of his professional accomplishments or the admiration he received from fans.

During a November 2022 interview with Canadian broadcaster Tom Power , the actor delivered a particularly stark assessment of alcoholism and its destructive consequences.

"Alcoholism did not care that I was on Friends," Perry said. "Alcoholism wants you alone; it wants you sick; and then it wants to kill you."

His comments reflected a realization that had taken years to accept, by becoming famous had fulfilled his greatest professional ambition, but it had not resolved the personal difficulties he believed success would overcome.

Why fame couldn't protect him from addiction

Perry 's struggles began long before Friends premiered in 1994, with the actor later revealing that he first consumed alcohol at 14 and was drinking regularly by his late teenage years.

As his career developed, substance dependence became an increasingly serious problem, leading to repeated rehabilitation attempts and significant medical complications.

Perry described addiction as a condition capable of overwhelming rational decisions, explaining that the desire to drink could dominate his thoughts even when other responsibilities demanded his attention.

He also discussed experiencing an inability to control his drinking once he started, using language associated with addiction recovery programs to describe the compulsive nature of his behavior.

At the height of his difficulties, Perry was struggling with prescription painkillers while continuing to portray Chandler Bing, the sarcastic and quick-witted character who made him internationally famous.

In his interview with Power , the actor revealed that watching old Friends episodes had become painful because he could identify periods of substance use through changes in his physical appearance.

Perry wanted struggles to become a source of hope

Perry documented his experiences in his 2022 memoir, Friends, Lovers, and the Big Terrible Thing, offering a detailed account of his addiction, recovery attempts and the personal consequences of his illness.

Rather than presenting himself solely as a victim of those experiences, he increasingly emphasized the importance of helping others who were facing similar difficulties.

During an interview with Diane Sawyer , Perry explained that his public profile gave him an opportunity to reach people who might otherwise feel isolated by addiction.

"Obviously, because I was on Friends, more people will listen to me," he said. "So I've got to take advantage of that, and I've got to help as many people as I can."

Perry died in October 2023 at the age of 54, but his willingness to speak openly about addiction remains an important part of his legacy.

His warning about alcoholism continues to resonate because it challenges the assumption that wealth, recognition or professional achievement can eliminate serious personal struggles.

More importantly, his experiences demonstrate why seeking support, speaking honestly and accessing appropriate treatment can be essential steps toward recovery.

articles.title: Fans slam Kim Kardashian for ‘betraying’ Ivanka Trump with post-election post
articles.standfirst: The reality star's seemingly innocent television promotion sparked a wave of criticism as Democrats celebrated a major midterm victory
articles.summary: The reality star's seemingly innocent television promotion sparked a wave of criticism as Democrats celebrated a major midterm victory
articles.body:
K im Kardashian has found herself at the center of a political backlash after sharing a post-election message that some followers interpreted as celebrating the Democrats ' sweeping midterm victory, despite her close relationship with Ivanka Trump . The 46-year-old Kim posted “GOOD MORNING AMERICA” on X.com, formerly known as Twitter, following Tuesday's elections, referring to her appearance on the ABC program to promote the latest season of her drama series, All's Fair .

However, the caption quickly attracted a different interpretation as with Democrats taking control of Congress , several social media users accused her of celebrating a result that represented a major setback for President Donald Trump and his Republican allies. And one critic questioned her friendship with the President's daughter, writing online, “Do you think she posted this before or after she checked in on her best friend Ivanka?” Another user responded, “Oh wtf lol it’s comical how you lack the ability to read the room.” Others questioned where Kardashian's political loyalties stood as a third commenter said, “You look good but we know you MAGA.”

Kim Kardashian's relationship with Ivanka explained

The backlash unfolded against the backdrop of a major political defeat for Republicans , with Democrats taking control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate in the midterm elections. The result was viewed as a significant rejection of the Trump Administration , with concerns over the cost of living, the Iran war and the POTUS ' approval ratings among the factors contributing to the Republican losses. Democrats also benefited from strong campaigns focused on healthcare affordability and household finances, whilst shifts among Hispanic and black voters further weakened Republican support in several key races. Although Kardashian' s television promotion was not explicitly presented as a political statement, its timing proved enough to spark criticism as her friendship with Ivanka has made the reaction particularly notable, with fans questioning how the reality star's public message fits alongside her connections to the Trump Family . Kardashian 's association with Ivanka has attracted attention because of their different public profiles and the reality star's previous involvement with the Trump administration. The pair developed a relationship through Kardashian 's criminal justice reform advocacy, which brought her into contact with Ivanka and her husband, Jared Kushner , during Trump 's first presidency. In 2018, Kardashian visited the White House for a meeting that lasted approximately an hour as she spoke with Trump about Alice Johnson , who was serving a life sentence following a 1996 conviction involving drug dealing and money laundering. Johnson 's case had attracted Kardashian 's attention because it was her first offense and she had played a minor role in the cocaine operation, and Kim subsequently left the White House and visited Kushner and Ivanka at their Washington D.C. , home. Johnson was later granted clemency and received a full presidential pardon, marking a significant development in Kardashian 's campaign for criminal justice reform.

articles.title: Leon Trotsky, politician: “Socialism means a leap from the realm of necessity to the realm of freedom”
articles.standfirst: This quote originally belongs to the thinker Friedrich Engels, but the defender of Marxism also coined it
articles.summary: This quote originally belongs to the thinker Friedrich Engels, but the defender of Marxism also coined it
articles.body:
Born in 1879, Leon Trotsky was a politician and Marxist revolutionary who played a key role in the Russian Civil War and the establishment of the Soviet Union. He became president of the Saint Petersburg Soviet on October 6, 1905. Three years earlier he had gone into exile. In 1917 he joined the Bolsheviks and was also elected president of the Petrograd Soviet. Finally, he went into exile and died in 1940.

Trotsky was one of the main defenders of Marxism. In one of his speeches, he uttered a quote that originally belonged to Friedrich Engels, but which he himself coined. It stated that “socialism means a leap from the realm of necessity to the realm of freedom”. Below, we break down the meaning of this reflection.

What is the realm of necessity and freedom, according to Trotsky?

First of all, when Trotsky speaks of the realm of necessity, he is referring to the state in which human beings are subject to all kinds of economic laws, taxes, scarcity, and the struggle to survive in this world. That is, to capitalism, in which all people are completely alienated from their own control.

Then, he mentions the leap to freedom. That is, Marxism. For Trotsky, this does not mean doing whatever each person prefers and what suits them best at any given moment, but rather that their actions are in the service of the rest of the community and humanity. According to the Russian thinker, it must be human beings themselves who build their own history and legacy.

Thus, it is not history that shapes its citizens, but rather the citizens who shape their different histories. For Trotsky, this would not be possible if humanity does not adapt to socialism and its different ideas. Only in this way, according to the Russian thinker, will freedom be a possibility.
